segments.oily: A reviewer with a very oily forehead says the adhesive lost its grip after the second use, though it did smooth her lines while it stayed on.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer who is normally allergic to most adhesives reports no reaction to this medical-grade silicone version, while others describe a persistent red mark or a rash-like reaction after use.
segments.mature: A 49-year-old reviewer who had struggled with forehead '11' lines for years reports the mask, worn overnight, kept her from furrowing her brow in her sleep and softened the lines.

concerns.aging: The majority of reviewers report visibly smoother, reduced forehead lines and '11s' with consistent overnight use, some noticing a difference within days; a few say they saw no improvement at all despite following the directions.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the mask plumping and hydrating forehead skin when layered over a serum, including one who uses it to counter the dehydration of air travel.
concerns.redness: One reviewer developed a red mark after a single short use that had not faded months later, and another reports a rash-like reaction across several uses with different serums.
concerns.oiliness: A reviewer with a very oily forehead reports the mask's adhesive stopped sticking after just one or two uses, unlike reviewers with drier or freshly cleansed skin.

extraits.texte: It lost its stickiness after my second use even when I washed as directed. I have a very oily forehead so maybe that's why. I wouldn't recommend if you have oily skin. It did help with my lines when I was able to use it.

so I used this a few months ago. the first time I used it I tried to put just enough peptide serum underneath it. I followed the directions so that it would still stick but I did have product under it. I took it off after probably 20 minutes and noticed a red mark on my forehead. after a few months the red mark is still not gone. it is noticeable and I am frustrated. I personally think you're going to get better results from just using a sheet mask. I wanted to use a peptide serum with mine so I would just replace it with a peptide sheet mask.

I sleep with mine on and apply a peptide serum underneath to prevent dynamic wrinkles since I'm in my late 20s and wanna keep the nice skin I worked to achieve. I also love that it's medical grade silicone, as I am allergic to most adhesives but not this.

extraits.titre: Wear All Night & Say Goodbye to 11s!
extraits.texte: I'm 49 and have struggled with the "forehead 11" for a couple of years. They look particularly awful when I wake up in the morning because apparently I furrow my brow while sleeping. I started wearing this patch all night long and it prevents me from furrowing my brow in my sleep. The 11s look so much better - like fine lines and not deep ones. I can't live without this! I wish they were more affordable as I typically have to replace them about every 4-6 weeks.

extraits.titre: works best on clean dry skin
extraits.texte: in contrast with the instructions, I use this on freshly washed and dried skin so it sticks for a longer period of time. I'm in my mid 30s and just starting to get fine lines that stick around for longer than I like, but this temporarily smooths them out and would help if I was consistent. I just wish the silicone was a little bit thinner as I think that would help it not lift at the parameter and that it was transparent. I have a pretty large forehead so I haven't needed to trim this. I really like taking it on trips where I have to fly because my skin is so dehydrated afterwards and this helps plump up the skin on my forehead, then I moisturize as usual
I was bummed. I didn't see any difference on my forehead. I even left it on overnight.
